blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over ChariTimba food packs to Mayor Dann Isaiah Lusterio of Binuangan, Misamis Oriental, during a ceremony on October 5, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office on Shaw Boulevard, Mandaluyong City. Mayor Lusterio personally received the ChariTimba from PCSO Executive Assistant VI Atty. María Katrina Nicole Contacto-Ventanilla. According to the mayor, the ChariTimba food packs will be distributed to constituents who are most in need of assistance. The distribution of ChariTimba is part of the PCSO’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program, which provides assistance to communities and families in need.
